title: Morgan Elsbeth
subtitle: Galactic Empire
description: The former magistrate of Calodan, Morgan Elsbeth was arrested and charged with being an Imperial Sympathizer. However, Morgan was able to escape, and her search for Grand Admiral Thrwan continued, reaching new levels as she crept ever closer to him. Allying herself with Baylan Skoll and his apprentice, Shin Hati, Elsbeth is awarded with the Gift of Shadows by the Great Mothers, generating the Blade of Talzin for her to wield.
